full_judgment: 2. The petitioners filed an application before the learned Subordinate Judge, 3rd Court, Sylhet alleging, inter alia, that opposite party Md. Jahur Ali as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 48 of 1989 against the petitioners before the Subordinate Judge 2nd Court, Sylhet, which on transfer to the Court of Subordinate Judge, 3rd Court, Sylhet was renumbered as Title Suit No. 197 of 1994, praying for declaration of title and recovery of Khas possession in respect of the land described in schedule 1 of the plaint and also for permanent injunction in respect of the properties mentioned in schedules 2 and 3 of the plaint. The present petitioners and their co-sharers as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No. 7 of 1995 before the Subordinate Judge, 3rd Court, Sylhet against the opposite party and another named Ranabir Sharma Purukaistha praying for declaration of Title in the Suit land, which is the property mentioned in schedule 1 to the plaint of Title Suit No. 197 of 1994, on the basis of an agreement for sale followed by delivery of possession but because of intervening circumstances the seller could not execute and register the sale deed in terms of the stipulations envisaged in the agreement.
